policy: Recovery procedures are plans until a real target, accountable owner, approved backup location, recovery point objective, recovery time objective, rollback authority and test evidence are confirmed. The repository drill is temporary-fixture-only and must never be represented as production recovery verification.

safeguards.rollback: fixture_only; production rollback requires owner approval and validated backup
safeguards.crypto: paper_only; no wallet, key, signature, order or live execution

procedures.name: Backup integrity verification
acceptance: Record backup timestamp and immutable artifact reference

procedures.name: Restore validation
acceptance: Restore to an isolated target first
Record data-loss window and measured recovery duration
Obtain owner approval before production restoration

procedures.name: Rollback validation
acceptance: Require owner approval before production rollback

procedures.name: Restart and health verification
acceptance: Document approved service owner and restart procedure
Restart only in a permitted test environment
Verify health endpoint and dependent services

drill_result: CI validates temporary-fixture mechanics only; no production recovery claim.
